pairs: Quod factum est verbum Domini ad Jeremiam prophetam contra gentes.
The word of the Lord that came to Jeremiah the prophet against the Gentiles,
adversum exercitum Pharaonis Nechao regis Ægypti,
against the army of Pharaoh Neco, the king of Egypt,
qui erat juxta fluvium Euphraten in Charcamis,
which was beside the river Euphrates at Carchemish,
which Nebuchadnezzar, the king of Babylon, struck down,
in quarto anno Joakim filii Josiæ regis Juda.
in the fourth year of Jehoiakim, the son of Josiah, the king of Judah:
“‘Prepare the heavy and the light shield,
and let the horsemen climb upon them!
Let not the swift take flight;
let not the strong ones think to save themselves.
ad aquilonem juxta flumen Euphraten victi sunt,
They have been conquered and ruined, toward the north,
et veluti fluviorum intumescunt gurgites ejus?
and whose streams swell up, like those of the rivers?
Egypt ascends in the form of a river,
et velut flumina movebuntur fluctus ejus,
and its waves will be moved like those of a river.
‘I will ascend and cover the earth!
I will perish the city and its inhabitants!’
et exsultate in curribus, et procedant fortes,
and exult upon chariots, and let the strong ones advance:
the Ethiopians, and the Libyans, who hold the heavy shield,
et Lydii arripientes et jacientes sagittas.
and the Lydians, who grasp and shoot arrows.
Dies autem ille Domini Dei exercituum dies ultionis,
For this is the day of the Lord, the God of hosts, a day of vengeance,
ut sumat vindictam de inimicis suis:
so that he may vindicate himself of his enemies.
and be inebriated with their blood. For there is a victim of the Lord,
victima enim Domini Dei exercituum in terra aquilonis juxta flumen Euphraten.
the God of hosts, in the land of the north, beside the river Euphrates.
It is in vain that you multiply medicines;
there will be no health for you!
The nations have heard of your disgrace,
and your wailing has filled the earth.
For the strong have stumbled against the strong,
Verbum quod locutus est Dominus ad Jeremiam prophetam,
The word that the Lord spoke to Jeremiah the prophet,
super eo quod venturus esset Nabuchodonosor rex Babylonis,
concerning how Nebuchadnezzar, the king of Babylon,
would arrive and strike the land of Egypt:
and make it heard in Migdol,
and let it resonate in Memphis
quia devorabit gladius ea quæ per circuitum tuum sunt.
For the sword will devour everything around you.
Why have your strong ones decayed?
because the Lord has overthrown them.
He has multiplied those in ruin,
and each man has fallen beside his neighbor.
and let us return to our own people
and to the land of our nativity,
away from the face of the sword of the dove.
Call the name of Pharaoh, the king of Egypt:
says the King, whose name is the Lord of hosts,
just as Tabor is among the mountains,
et sicut Carmelus in mari, veniet.
and just as Carmel is beside the sea, so will he come.
For Memphis will be in desolation,
Egypt is like a stately and finely-formed calf.
The one who will goad her will come from the north.
qui versabantur in medio ejus quasi vituli saginati,
like fatted calves have been turned back,
and they have fled at the same time,
and they are not able to stand firm.
quia dies interfectionis eorum venit super eos,
For the day of their passing away has overwhelmed them;
it is the time of their visitation.
Her voice will sound out like brass.
For they will rush forward with an army,
et cum securibus venient ei quasi cædentes ligna.
and with axes they will come against her, like those who chop wood.
They have cut down her forest,
which was not able to be counted.
They have been multiplied more than locusts,
The daughter of Egypt has been confounded,
et tradita in manu populi aquilonis.
and she has been delivered into the hand of the people of the north.
The Lord of hosts, the God of Israel,
Ecce ego visitabo super tumultum Alexandriæ,
I will visit against the tumult of Alexandria,
et super eos qui confidunt in eo:
and against those who trust in him.
et dabo eos in manu quærentium animam eorum,
And I will give them over to the hand of those who seek their lives,
et in manu Nabuchodonosor regis Babylonis,
and into the hand of Nebuchadnezzar, the king of Babylon,
and into the hand of his servants.
et post hæc habitabitur sicut diebus pristinis,
And after this, it shall be inhabited, just as in the former days,
And as for you, my servant Jacob,
quia ecce ego salvum te faciam de longinquo,
O Israel. For behold, I will bring your salvation from afar,
et semen tuum de terra captivitatis tuæ:
and your offspring from the land of your captivity.
And Jacob will return and have rest,
et non erit qui exterreat eum.
And there will be no one who may terrify him.
Et tu noli timere, serve meus Jacob,
And as for you, my servant Jacob,
says the Lord. For I am with you.
quia ego consumam cunctas gentes ad quas ejeci te,
For I will consume all the nations to which I have cast you out.
Yet truly, I will not consume you.
Instead, I will chastise you in judgment,
but neither will I spare you, as if you were innocent.”
